records.author: Copilot
records.body:
Bootstrap repository for GPT-AJ04 (BrandGuard™) guardrails system with complete folder structure, documentation, and metadata files.

## Structure

- **Core folders**: `/prompts`, `/src/corpus`, `/src/transcripts`, `/eval`, `/build`, `/ops`
- **Documentation**: Enhanced README with Tone Keeper, Ethics Sentinel, and Framing Navigator component descriptions
- **Links**: Notion workspace, askjamie.bot hub, GPT interface
- **Metadata**: CHANGELOG.md, MIT LICENSE, .gitignore

## Repository Layout

```
AskJamie-GPT-AJ04/
├── prompts/          # Guardrail instruction sets
├── src/
│   ├── corpus/       # Knowledge base
│   └── transcripts/  # Conversation logs
├── eval/             # Test cases and metrics
├── build/            # Artifacts
└── ops/              # Deployment configs
```

Each folder includes README or .gitkeep to enable tracking while preserving clean structure.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Create a new GitHub repository named AskJamie-GPT-AJ04. Initialize with README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, and .gitignore. Add folders: /prompts, /src/corpus, /src/transcripts, /eval, /build, /ops. README should describe GPT-AJ04 (AskJamie™ — OKHP³ BrandGuard™): guardrails for tone, ethics, identity & framing (Tone Keeper, Ethics Sentinel, Framing Navigator). Include links to Notion, the AskJamie hub page, and the GPT.
> 


</details>



<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT TIPS -->

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Align manifest identity with AJ04 repository**

The manifest declares `GPT-BRG03` for “Brooks Running,” which conflicts with this repo’s AJ04/BrandGuard identity. Any tooling that consumes `gpt_manifest.yaml` for naming, links, or deployment metadata will mislabel this project or publish it under the wrong brand, leading to incorrect assets or configuration being used in downstream systems. Please update the manifest fields to match the AJ04 project identity.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
